findings.observation: Insert path ignores the token and nothing makes the row unique: 'context.EveryoneSignedInSettings.Add(EveryoneSignedInSetting.StoredAs(everyoneCanView));'. Two first PUTs on an unseeded DB can create two rows; later writes edit only the oldest, so the rule stays sound, the second row is dead weight. Advisory, low.
findings.remediation: Accept and note (seeder creates the row at start-up) or add a unique guard later.

findings.obligation: Effect separation; no sync I/O in async path
findings.observation: 'return TheSwitch.Any(setting => setting.EveryoneCanView);' is a synchronous DB read reached through Func<bool> from a Lazy on the request thread. Behaviour correct; blocks a thread on the first unit question. Advisory, low.
findings.remediation: Optional: resolve the switch asynchronously before Resolve and pass a bool.
